en.headline: 11th Belt and Road Summit opens in Hong Kong today
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the two-day forum, themed on high-quality development, will continue to leverage the city’s advantages under “one country, two systems” to support the initiative.
body: The 11th Belt and Road Summit opens in Hong Kong on Wednesday, with Chief Executive John Lee describing the event as a top-tier platform for officials, business leaders and young talent from more than 120 countries and regions.

Speaking on social media after hosting a welcome dinner for overseas guests on Tuesday evening, Lee said the summit has over the past decade attracted more than 45,000 participants and facilitated over 3,100 cooperation projects worldwide. This year’s theme is “Promoting High-Quality Development, Embarking on a New Journey”.

The two-day gathering at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre features new thematic sessions on “going global”, Central Asia and the Middle East, as well as discussions on artificial intelligence, low-altitude economy and urban development. Lee said Hong Kong would continue to play an active role as a participant, contributor and beneficiary of the Belt and Road Initiative.

zh.headline: 第十一屆一帶一路高峰論壇今開幕
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超表示，論壇以「推動高質量發展 共啟新征程」為主題，香港將繼續發揮「一國兩制」優勢助力倡議。
body: 由特區政府與香港貿易發展局合辦的第十一屆「一帶一路高峰論壇」周三在香港會議展覽中心開幕。行政長官李家超周二晚設宴歡迎海外政商界領袖，並在社交平台表示論壇已成為頂級交流平台。
李家超指出，過去十年論壇累計吸引逾120個「一帶一路」國家和地區、合共超過4萬5,000名官員及商界翹楚參與，促成全球逾3,100個合作項目。今屆主題為「推動高質量發展 共啟新征程」，並新設「出海專章」、「中亞專章」及「中東專章」等環節。
他強調香港在「一國兩制」下擁有背靠祖國、聯通世界的獨特優勢，未來會繼續擔當積極參與者、貢獻者及受益者，配合國家推動高質量發展。
